darpa_baseline.name: JUXTAPOSE — Experimental Adaptive Search Architecture for Resilient Communications
darpa_baseline.primary_scope: Adaptive exact-backed search ordering for authorized paths/transports under DDIL conditions.
darpa_baseline.central_rule: Learn where to look; never learn what is true.
darpa_baseline.state_model: Candidate path/transport field + structural metadata + exact connectivity receipts.
darpa_baseline.claim_ceiling: Independent evaluation and controlled hardware/network validation justified; no field superiority or external replication established.

delta_summary.strongest_progress: JUXTAPOSE v5.1 primarily governed where to search; the current system additionally governs what exact representation carries future semantics, what operations are certified, how transformations are independently replayed, and where computational cost/debt may hide.
delta_summary.remaining_ceiling: The current architecture is much broader and stricter, but it still has no universal polynomial lifecycle theorem and therefore has not resolved P vs NP.
